consent.title: Cookies on this site
consent.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to make the site work. With your permission we'd also use cookies for advertising, which keeps the calculators free, and for privacy-respecting analytics. You can change this any time.
consent.necessaryNote: Always on. Needed for the site to function; stores nothing about you.
consent.analyticsNote: Aggregate page-view counts so we know which tools are useful. No personal profile.
consent.advertisingNote: Lets ad providers show relevant ads. This is what funds the free tools.
